**Subject:** Acme Q1 Market Data Information

Hi Priya,

Per our principal's request, please find below the Acme-specific Q1 market data information directly from the client's briefing records:

1. 2026-01-06 | Category Share (Protein Bars): 18.4%, US total (Nielsen scanner Q4–Q1 pull) – share up 60bps QoQ, driven by club channel reset.
2. 2026-01-12 | Retail Velocity (Protein Bar SKU): 4.7 units/store/week, US total (IRI scan) – steady, top-3 SKU in category.
3. 2026-01-15 | Regional Momentum Southeast: +12% YoY, US southeast (Acme syndicated dashboard) – strongest region, pull-through from Walmart reset.
4. 2026-01-23 | Promo Lift January: +22% during MLK weekend reset, US total (Acme syndicated dashboard) – outperformed planned +15%.
5. 2026-02-03 | Category Share (Protein Bars): 18.6%, US total (Nielsen scanner Feb pull) – share holding, Verdant flat; see analyst note.
6. 2026-02-08 | Retail Velocity (Protein Bar SKU): 4.9 units/store/week, US total (IRI scan) – uptick, Q1 promo driving trial.
7. 2026-02-16 | Regional Momentum West: +8% YoY, US west (Acme syndicated dashboard) – below plan +12%, competitive pressure from private label.
8. 2026-02-22 | Share of Voice Digital: 33% of category SOV, US total (Pathmatics digital ad scrape) – leading category, Verdant at 24%.
9. 2026-02-27 | Promo Lift February: +18% during Super Bowl window, US total (Acme syndicated dashboard) – met plan.
10. 2026-03-08 | Category Share (Protein Bars): 18.9%, US total (Nielsen scanner March pull) – share continuing to grow, Verdant flat-to-down.
11. 2026-03-18 | Retail Velocity (Protein Bar SKU): 5.1 units/store/week, US total (IRI scan) – best Q1 reading, momentum continues.
12. 2026-03-25 | Regional Momentum Northeast: +9% YoY, US northeast (Acme syndicated dashboard) – steady, no notable competitive shifts.
13. 2026-03-30 | Share of Voice Digital: 34% of category SOV, US total (Pathmatics digital ad scrape) – steady leadership, recommend hold spend in Q2.

If you require the full data file or need additional details, please let us know.

Best regards,  
Daniel Park  
Pinecrest Strategy Group

---

Let me know how you would like to proceed!
